Nutrition Therapy for Constipation
Historically, nutritional treatment of constipation has con-
centrated on the role of adequate ﬁ ber and ﬂ uid intake. Th is
is despite the overall lack of outcomes research for the role of 
ﬁ ber in gastrointestinal disease.63, 64 Survey data have indicated 
most Americans consume an average of 15 grams of ﬁ ber each
day. A more recent report indicates that Americans aged 1 year
and older are estimated to consume approximately 4.9 g resis-
